name: 30705 · Chatsworth, GA
findings: ZIP 30705 (Chatsworth) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30705 (Chatsworth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30705 (Chatsworth) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 23% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
